title: Azusawa Kohane — A Heart-Pounding World〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Cemetery

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, I think we're just about finished here, so let's start heading back!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Sounds good.
No one forgot anything, right?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Wait, sorry!
Gimme a second to go put back the ladle and bucket!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay, go for it!
se_run_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'm so glad that we got to come here today.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Nagi...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huff... Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: RUST Member A
rows.Line: You sounded pretty amazing, but this first bout's a loss for you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: RUST Member A
rows.Line:
That makes twelve in total.
You have to defeat us one at a time.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A-All twelve of you...?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (What...?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (They're better than the others...? But there are so many of them...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (When I was battling against everyone from RUST and GLaP day...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I realized that you and your team constantly competed with these really amazing singers and won, Nagi.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (And each day, I was given a brutal reminder of just how incredible you were.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But because of everything you accomplished, I'm now able to say...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, did I just say that out loud?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, who were you thanking?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um, I was just thinking...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: How Nagi, An's dad and Taiga spent every day on Vivid Street competing against RUST, GLaP day... All these really amazing singers...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And how their accomplishments led us to where we are now.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: They led us...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I see.
I think I know what you mean, Azusawa.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The bigger your hero's feats, the more likely it is that you'll have trouble surpassing them... But the sense of accomplishment you feel when you do is unmatchable.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Exactly. And I feel like we were able to reach the zenith of that night because Nagi paved the way first.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Which is why I felt the need to thank her.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And you couldn't help but say it out loud?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. It's so like you to do that, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It is...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah. You're honest, hard-working...
And you treasure every moment you've experienced, don't you?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You're the kind of person Aunt Nagi loved the most. I'm sure she's smiling at you from up above right now!

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Haha. Yeah!
She did have that kind of personality.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Sh-She did...?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Haha. Maybe she and An would've even fought over you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What? Me and Aunt Nagi fighting over Kohane...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No, even if she groveled and begged, I'd never let her have Kohane...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay?

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: You're so popular, Azusawa.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: U-Uhh... Haha...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That being said...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm still your partner no matter what, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You taught me that I could feel this incredible kind of excitement.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I had nothing going on in my life...
But now I have something I really love doing and have a better understanding of my ego.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Nagi showed us the path, but you've been walking with me every step of the way, An.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Also, I...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I can confidently say now that no singer other than me is worthy of performing by your side!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I want to keep feeling that way and being able to say that... I think...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Why'd you add that qualifier at the end?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Humility is a virtue, is it not...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Just one reason why Kohane's the best partner ever!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
You saying that makes me so happy.
So, let's keep doing our best together! Partner!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: *Nod*
se_run_men_001_2

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Hey, you guys!
I put the ladle and bucket back!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, you're back!
Then, let's head out.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Still, Azusawa, you've become so dependable.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Yes, I agree.
We'll need to do our best to make similar strides.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you...!
We also plan to keep doing our best.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
See, Aunt Nagi?
Isn't she just the best partner ever?
